summary: Verified batch-2 sales-readiness relabels on /quick-order and Foundation Print $29.99 on Meal Bundle. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. UI tested with Playwright against public preview URL. Backend /api/payments/products returned 200. No JS crashes on /, /quick-order, /checkout.

'Offline Game Master — Breakfast Edition' still exposes 'Breakfast' (1 occurrence). Consider renaming to 'Foundation in Christ Edition' for consistency with batch-2 relabels.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If batch-2 relabels are meant to be exhaustive, rename Free Resources 'Holiday Bonus (Adult/Youth)' tiles and 'Offline Game Master — Breakfast Edition' to remove customer-facing 'Holiday'/'Breakfast'. Otherwise, no action required — all 6 stated acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickOrder.js is 2307 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the product catalog data, cover mapping, and format-label logic into modules for maintainability.

Two parallel product-name maps exist (backend STORE_PRODUCTS with underscores using 'Break*fast'/'Holiday' names, and price_catalog.py with hyphens). Payment server admin surfaces may still leak the legacy 'Break*fast' name from STORE_PRODUCTS. Consider aligning STORE_PRODUCTS names to the batch-2 customer-facing labels if these are ever surfaced to customers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch-2 relabels (C) and Foundation Print (E) verified on /quick-order. If next iteration expands scope to Free Resources bonus tiles or Game Master naming, focus tests there. Cart→Checkout subtotal enforcement path is $product.id-$edition-$format for meal-cards (e.g., 'breakfast-adult-physical'), but price_catalog uses 'breakfast-meal-adult-physical' — worth confirming backend server actually maps cart id ↔ catalog key correctly for max(client,catalog) enforcement.
